The current market capitalization sits at ₹ 51.0 Cr [E2], while the stock rests near the bottom of its yearly range at only 10% of the way up its 52-week span [E4], offering substantial room for re-pricing as profitability metrics take hold. Conceded: the company carries a negative return on equity of -37.53% [E8], a negative return on assets of -15.94% [E7], and has experienced a severe contraction in compounded sales growth of -94% over the trailing twelve months [E16].
